parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region.

parameters.name: NewResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the instance. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-resource-group --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --new-resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
